items.title: The zero section of a line bundle: regularity, pushforward, pullback and Chern class formulae
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma collects six formulae for the zero section of a line bundle: the zero section is the vanishing scheme of a regular global section of the inverse of the pulled back invertible sheaf, the induced pushforward and pullback, the identity of the composite with the flat pullback, and the two Chern class formulae for the pushforward and for the composite of the pullback with the pushforward (statement lines 5774-5790, tag 0F96). The first assertion needs the projection formula and the structure of the pushforward of the structure sheaf, while the remaining ones are assembled from the effective Cartier divisor formulae together with additivity and flat pullback compatibility of the Chern class. The identification of the section is the substance, so the claim is H2.
